# MovieRate - Movie & TV Show Discovery and Reviews Platform

> MovieRate is an intelligent movie recommendation and rating engine offering comprehensive movie metadata, actor and director credits, user ratings and reviews, and personalized AI-driven movie recommendations.

## Platform Capabilities
- **Extensive Catalog**: Over thousands of movies categorized across 21 genres including Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Crime, Horror, Sci-Fi, Animation, and more.
- **Accurate Metadata**: Real-time release years, durations, TMDB-backed ratings, cast & crew with verified photos and character mappings.
- **Personalized Recommendations**: Hybrid filtering engine combining collaborative filtering and content-based embedding similarity.
- **Community Reviews**: Authentic audience reviews, sentiment scoring, and watchlists.

## Primary Endpoints & Pages
- Homepage: /
- Genres Index: /genres
- Individual Genre Catalog: /genres/:genre
- Movie Detail & Reviews: /movie/:id
- Recommendations: /recommendations
- Community / Leaderboard: /community
- User Profile & Watchlist: /profile

## Machine-Readable Semantic Schema
All movie pages render Schema.org JSON-LD `Movie` entities with:
- `@context`: https://schema.org
- `@type`: Movie
- `name`, `description`, `image`, `datePublished`, `aggregateRating`
- `actor` list, `director` list, and `review` collection.
